snippet.title: Memoriapolis - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Your reign begins April 30th. Will your city stand the test of time?
Memoriapolis is available on Steam 👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/2228280/MEMORIAPOLIS/

FIVE AGES. ONE CITY. Memoriapolis spans 5 historical eras—from Antiquity all the way to the Industrial Revolution, each more challenging and rewarding than the last.

🌳 Manage resources,
⚖️ Make political decisions.
📜​ Face historical events, 
🏛️ Build wonders.
👑 And leave your mark in history! 

For news and details on Memoriapolis, visit https://playmemoriapolis.com or follow Memoriapolis on social media:
🤍​ Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2228280/MEMORIAPOLIS/
💙​ Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/fivepmstudio
🧡​ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/5_pm_studio/ 
💜​ Discord: https://discord.gg/N4XvMJZ3eV
